english.title: Unauthorised use of mobile phone - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[operated a mobile phone in an airside fuelling area]_
(B)_[operated a mobile phone at Liverpool John Lennon Airport after an airport official or constable had requested you not to do so for operational reasons or in times of emergency]_
(C)_[failed when so requested by an airport official or constable at Liverpool John Lennon Airport to ensure that a mobile phone was turned off]_

without first obtaining the permission of Liverpool Airport Limited to do so
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(c) and 4(20) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
